templates.name: api-client
templates.description: Wrap a third-party HTTP API as MCP tools: fetch and search tools plus a config resource.
templates.author: mcp-forge

extra_files.TEMPLATE_NOTES.md:
# {{project_name}} (api-client template)

This project was installed from the mcp-forge api-client template.

Next steps:

1. Implement `fetch_url` and `search` in `src/{{pkg_name}}/tools.py` against your API.
2. Put API base URL and settings behind the `config://settings` resource in `src/{{pkg_name}}/resources.py`.
3. Keep secrets out of the resource payload. Read keys from environment variables inside the tool handlers instead.
4. Run `pytest`, then `mcp-forge test --cmd 'python -m {{pkg_name}}.server'`.

templates.name: knowledge-base
templates.description: Expose documents to LLM clients: a lookup tool, doc resources, and summarize plus answer prompts.
templates.author: mcp-forge

extra_files.TEMPLATE_NOTES.md:
# {{project_name}} (knowledge-base template)

This project was installed from the mcp-forge knowledge-base template.

Next steps:

1. Point `docs://index` and `docs://page` in `src/{{pkg_name}}/resources.py` at your document store.
2. Implement `lookup` in `src/{{pkg_name}}/tools.py` to search that store.
3. Tune the `summarize_doc` and `answer_from_docs` prompts in `src/{{pkg_name}}/prompts.py`.
4. Run `pytest`, then `mcp-forge test --cmd 'python -m {{pkg_name}}.server'`.
